notes: Printed: 'Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Two lifelink creatures attack together. The trampling 5/5 is blocked by a 0/2 and assigns 2 to it and 3 to the player; the 2/2 is unblocked. One source's damage dealt at once is one life-gain event, whatever the number of recipients (CR 120.3f; this card's ruling: 'if a single creature you control with lifelink deals combat damage to multiple creatures, players, planeswalkers, and/or battles at the same time ..., the ability will apply only once'), and two sources are two (its ruling: 'each creature with lifelink dealing combat damage causes a separate life-gain event'): gains of 5 and 2 (20 -> 27), two counters. On 46aa2f3e, before the lifelink fix, each recipient was its own gain: 2, 3 and 2, three counters.
